planted.description: Generic repository and unit of work over DbContext. Over-engineering: DbContext already is both.
EnableSensitiveDataLogging in all environments. Only in Development.
Global NoTracking: the shipment endpoint loads the order through the repository, changes it, and SaveChanges does not save the status change.
EnsureCreated before Migrate at startup: EnsureCreated makes the schema without the migrations history, then Migrate fails. Migrations at startup need a team decision (DATA-18).
Guid.NewGuid() for the key. Decision DATA-07 says the provider generates the key (UUIDv7).
DateTime for an instant (and DateTime.Now is written to it). Use DateTimeOffset like Order; local DateTime fails on timestamptz in Npgsql.
OwnsOne for a value object. In EF Core 10 use ComplexProperty.
No concurrency token on the shipment (and order status changes have none). Add [Timestamp] uint Version (xmin) and handle DbUpdateConcurrencyException.
DateTime.Now (local time) written to PostgreSQL. Use TimeProvider.GetUtcNow().
SQL injection: interpolated string in FromSqlRaw (EF1002). Use FromSql or LINQ.
N+1 queries: one query per order in a loop. Use one query with a join or Contains.
Case-insensitive search with ToLower() (no index use). Use EF.Functions.ILike or a collation.
